title: Te manaakitanga i kawea mai ai te wehi
intro: I roto i tētahi tāone kua horomia e te kino, i tae mai he manuhiri ohorere ki tētahi pononga pono i tētahi rā. Nā te āwangawanga mō tō rātou haumaru, i tuku tiaki tēnei tangata, engari i tono te iwi o te tāone i tētahi mea whakama. I te whakatūpatotanga mō tētahi aituā e tata mai ana, ka oma te pononga me tōna whānau i raro i te piringa o te pō, ka mahue iho he tāone kua tohua mō te whakangaromanga. Ko wai tēnei tangata whakapono mokemoke?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei karere ki tētahi iwi kua mahi i ngā mahi whakama.
I tae mai ngā manuhiri ohorere ki tōku kāinga, ā, nui atu tōku āwangawanga mō tō rātou haumaru i tōku ake.
I tono mai tōku iwi kia kite i aku manuhiri, he kino ngā take, ā, i ngana ahau ki te tautohetohe ki a rātou.
I whakakitea mai aku manuhiri he anahera rātou, ā, i whakahau mai kia haere ahau me tōku whānau i te pō.
Kāore taku wahine i whakarongo ki te karanga kia mawhiti, ā, i pāngia ia e te whakangaromanga kotahi, pērā i tōku iwi.
I hurihia tōku tāone e te ua o ngā kōhatu paru paparanga, ā, ko ōna wāhanga teitei rawa i tino heke iho.

arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verse: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." (11:80)
